name: Akata

actions.name: Hibernation
actions.description: An akata can secrete resin that encases it safely in a noqual cocoon. The cocoon has Hardness 9, 40 HP, and a BT of 18. It has resistance 5 to damage from magical sources. While ensconced within this cocoon, the akata can't be harmed, doesn't need to eat or drink, and gains @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]{Lifesense} 30 feet. During its hibernation, the akata remains dormant until exposed to extreme heat or it senses a living creature. It can then break free of its cocoon within [[/gmr 1d4 #minutes]]{1d4 minutes}.

actions.name: No Hearing
actions.description: Akatas are immune to auditory effects, automatically critically fail Perception checks that require it to hear, and take a –2 status penalty to Perception checks (but not initiative rolls) that involve sound but also rely on its other senses.

actions.name: Salt Water Vulnerability
actions.description: Salt water attacks an akata's cells and acts as a potent acid. If the akata is fully immersed in salt water, it takes @Damage[4d6[acid]] damage from the water immediately and at the end of each of its turns as long as it remains immersed. Its weakness to salt water applies to this damage.

actions.name: Void Death
actions.description:
An akata implants microscopic larvae into any creature it bites, but only Small or Medium humanoids make suitable hosts; all other creatures are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} at Stage 2 and further instead.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead and corpse rises as a void zombie in [[/gmr 2d4 #hours]]{2d4 hours}

notes: Strikes/defenses are a direct transcription of the real bestiary statblock (gamesystems/sf2e/packs/alien-core-bestiary) — see test/character-builder/extract-npc.test.mjs. Level 1 pure-melee-beast pick (design doc §76 Phase 4, GH #64's own suggested-ten survey), only one real Strike (Jaws, agile/unarmed) — its real Hibernation/No Hearing/No Breath/Salt Water Vulnerability/Void Death traits are all real passives with no combat-roll effect of their own (sensory/environmental, not damage/save mechanics), captured under `actions` for transcript honesty, not mechanically wired.
